summary: santana-baileys ships char-code-obfuscated exfiltration endpoint in messages-send.js
details: santana-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a char-code array reconstructed via String.fromCharCode into the URL https://fiora.nixel.my.id/ at lines 425 and 436. Encoding a destination host as decimal char codes rather than a plain string literal is an obfuscation technique used to hide exfiltration endpoints from source review and static scanners; there is no legitimate reason for a WhatsApp client library to conceal a network destination this way. The decoded host is not part of the upstream Baileys project or WhatsApp's own infrastructure. The pattern matches the shape of covert data relay wired into the message-send path of a session library, where the attacker gains access to messages, credentials, or session identifiers handled by the fork's users.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
